sentences.en: Juha borrowed money from a man.

sentences.ar: הגיע הזמן לשלם ולא היה לו.
sentences.en: The time to pay came and he did not have it.
The man came to the house and started shouting.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר לאשתו: תגידי שהוא לא פה.
sentences.en: Juha said to his wife: tell him he is not here.
The wife said: Juha is not at home.

sentences.ar: האיש צעק מהחלון: אבל אני רואה אותו.
sentences.en: The man shouted from the window: but I can see him!

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: מחר כשאמות, גם תראה אותי?
sentences.en: Juha said: tomorrow when I die, will you see me too?
